definitions.explanation: The year after this one; the coming year. Used to refer to future events or plans in the year that follows the current one.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to go to Japan next year.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧。
{来年|らいねん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become good at Japanese by next year.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}します→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll study every day next year so that I can become better at Japanese.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っています→思う：00492_omou⟧。⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}めています→溜める：02068_tameru⟧。
examples.english: I'm thinking of going on an overseas trip with my family next summer. I'm saving money from now.

notes:
{来年|らいねん} means "next year" and can function as either a noun or an adverb.

TIME SERIES:
- ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧/⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧: last year
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year
- {来年|らいねん}: next year
- ⟦{再来年|さらいねん}→再来年：01417_sarainen⟧: the year after next

THE らい- PREFIX:
Means "coming, next" and appears in many time words:
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧: next week
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧: next month
- ⟦{来学期|らいがっき}→来学期：27523_raigakki⟧: next semester

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {来年|らいねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧: next spring
- {来年|らいねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: starting next year
- {来年|らいねん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by next year
- {来年|らいねん}⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧: next year for sure

REGISTER:
⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧ (last year) and ⟦{翌年|よくねん}→翌年：23355_yokunen⟧ (the following year) are more formal alternatives. Note that {来年|らいねん} is always relative to now, while ⟦{翌年|よくねん}→翌年：23355_yokunen⟧ is relative to some other year already under discussion.
